_doc: The status checks the `main-protection` ruleset requires on `main`. The ruleset itself lives in GitHub settings, not in this repo, so this file is its committed mirror: scripts/check-merge-queue-readiness.ts reads it to prove every workflow job producing one of these names also runs (correctly) on the `merge_group` event, and docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md §16 cites it as the list to enter in the ruleset. Change the ruleset and this file in the same PR.
